item.title: Ethical Smart Grid: a Gym environment for learning ethical behaviours
item.description: Paper published in the Journal of Open-Source Software, alongside the source code for our ethical-smart-grid simulator. This simulator focuses on ethical behaviours within a Smart Grid, and is based on Gym (Reinforcement Learning).
